content: I'm designed to assist with a wide range of tasks including answering questions, providing explanations, summarizing information, assisting with learning new topics, generating text, and helping with problem-solving across various domains. I can handle tasks in education, technical subjects, general knowledge, entertainment, and more. Whether you need help understanding a complex topic, need guidance on a project, or just want to learn something new, I'm here to help with information and support.
